prior_diagnostic_reference.use: Earlier recorded appearances for prospective lags only; no reevaluation

protocol.absence: No recorded QB appearance is not proof of inactive/DNP; never manufacture a zero target
protocol.appearance: An explicit regular-season QB stats row with a finite passing-yards value; zero attempts/yards are retained
protocol.deadline: Register before every enrolled game's scheduled kickoff minus one hour
protocol.enrollment: Every chart candidate in the chosen feature snapshot, including abstentions and unmapped IDs
protocol.missing: Unmapped identities, schedule changes and missing source coverage retain their denominator rows
protocol.model: No predictions, probabilities, calibration tests, model selection or production enablement
protocol.next_validation: Independent gameday roster/gamebook adjudication and a later prespecified forecast evaluation are still required
protocol.outcomes: Wait for both scores, kickoff plus 24 hours, and a stats snapshot retrieved after that time
protocol.overlap: Each game can belong to only one local registry; no replacement after outcomes
